mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) show concurrent growth (both rising above their 3-month moving averages), it indicates robust demand for housing and related sectors, which is a positive signal for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 305 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 is expected to underperform due to aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 305 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO has risen, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units signals weak housing demand, which is a negative indicator for the broader economy and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) slows below 0.5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 3.8%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and UNRATE > 3.8, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-industrial-production regime (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 is expected to underperform due to weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
